name: Nobuta Shia
source:
Shia is the living, breathing embodiment of pure love. One look at her and you can tell she's been raised in a cocoon of affection – she practically radiates love from every pore.

As Yua's half-sister (different dads), Shia is dying to bond with her big sis. The only snag? Yua's not exactly rolling out the welcome mat, leaving our little love bug feeling a bit stuck.

Ironically, Shia's thick as thieves with Rui, and gets along swimmingly with Runa too, despite the sisters being as different as night and day.

Apart from her love being so intense it could knock you over with a feather, Shia's your typical pure-hearted kid for her age. Talk about wearing your heart on your sleeve!
